gen-gf-autour-one-gf-alexandria: Every stroke of Autour One ends at one measured thickness, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. Alexandria, a sans with a tall body, lets the heading carry the weight.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-amiko: Autour One keeps each stroke free of any heavy-to-light shift, so its round letters read bold and expressive. Autour One makes the statement; Amiko, with outward-pointing terminals, does the steady talking.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla reads friendly, with wide s curves barely curled in. Autour One, marker-like with a constant line, is the one to make the loud point; the sans-serif text just carries on.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-anek-devanagari: Autour One is bold and expressive, drawing each stroke with no swing between heavy and light, round letters included. Anek Devanagari takes the quieter job, with distinctly open mouths and tall middle.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-anek-gujarati: Lowercase that rivals the capitals gives this sans a friendly face against the constant pen-pressure look of Autour One. Anek Gujarati keeps its gaping c inviting paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Round and loud, Autour One gives its lowercase n an arch as sturdy as the stem, all of it expressive. Autour One announces; Anek Gurmukhi, with big open counters, does the explaining.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-anek-kannada: Autour One holds an unvarying line thickness, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. And Anek Kannada, tall in the x-height with terminals stopping far from the stem, feels contemporary beside it.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin keeps its lowercase tall, nearly touching the capitals, with letters held open rather than curled shut. And Autour One steps in up top, diagonals matching horizontals in weight, to supply the bold.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam keeps its capitals barely above the lowercase, and its curve tips never quite touch. Anek Malayalam handles the quiet reading while Autour One, rims matching its stems, takes the loud moments.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-anek-odia: Autour One is bold and expressive, turning every curve corner without any pressure swell. Anek Odia follows with unsealed rounds like unlatched hooks, keeping capitals only slightly above the lowercase.
